title: Surface or quarantine invalid Auto Memory inbox patches

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear and actionable report regarding memory inbox patch lifecycle management, identifying specific problems with invalid patch filtering and prompt context pollution.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Requires updating patch validation, aggregate dismiss, and inbox summary generation across `memoryService.ts`, `memoryPatchUtils.ts`, and `memory.ts`, as well as adding unit tests for malformed, hunk-less, and out-of-root patch handling.

summary.problem: Invalid memory patches (malformed, missing hunks, or targeting files outside the allowed memory root) are silently hidden from `/memory inbox` and aggregate dismiss actions, while still being included in the background extractor's pending inbox summary prompt context.
summary.root_cause: `listInboxMemoryPatches` and `listValidInboxPatchFiles` filter out invalid patch files without surfacing them or enabling dismissal, while `buildPendingInboxSummary` reads all `.patch` files on disk regardless of validity.
summary.context: Auto Memory inbox stores `.patch` files under `<memoryDir>/.inbox/{private,global}/`. Accumulating invalid patch files creates permanent invisible artifacts that pollute future extraction prompts.

steps: Update `buildPendingInboxSummary` in `packages/core/src/services/memoryService.ts` to only include memory patch files that pass validation (or utilize `listValidInboxPatchFiles`), preventing invalid patch files from leaking into extraction prompts.

Update memory patch handling in `packages/core/src/commands/memory.ts` and `packages/core/src/services/memoryPatchUtils.ts` so that invalid memory patch files (malformed, no hunks, or out-of-root) are either surfaced with an invalid state and dismiss action, quarantined, or cleaned up upon dismiss.
Ensure aggregate dismiss operations clean up non-actionable or invalid `.patch` files so they do not accumulate in the inbox directory.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Invalid memory patch files (malformed diffs, missing hunks, or out-of-root targets) are excluded from extraction prompts and can be dismissed or cleaned up from the memory inbox.
verification_steps: Add unit test cases in `memoryService.test.ts` verifying `buildPendingInboxSummary` excludes malformed patches, patches without hunks, and patches targeting files outside the allowed root.
Add unit test cases in `memory.test.ts` verifying that invalid patch files are properly surfaced, quarantined, or deleted when dismissing or applying inbox entries.
